# KING AI public facts
Canonical ecosystem website: https://www.kingai.work/
Canonical active public repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Public repository mode: single unified public hub.
Purpose: commercial product discovery, customer-safe public knowledge, ecosystem navigation, partnerships, SEO/GEO and verified public release references.

Core KING AI product family:
- KING AI / SEA — https://www.kingai.work/
- KINGAIBOT — controlled agentic work; public discovery through the unified hub
- KINGAI OS — https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS — https://ops.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security — https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Office — https://office.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS — https://kefu.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools — https://tools.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Pet — https://pet.kingai.work/
- AI Life — https://life.kingai.work/
- Digital Life — https://digital.kingai.work/

Public product roles:
- SEA: long-term intelligence, useful continuity, recurring work and memory direction.
- KINGAIBOT: outcome-oriented, controlled agentic assistance for longer digital work.
- KINGAI OS: AI-native computing direction.
- KINGAI OPS: server, infrastructure and edge operations with governed intelligent-operations direction.
- KINGAI Security: understandable protection, findings, quarantine/recovery and broader security direction.
- KINGAI Office: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and intelligent productivity.
- Customer OS: approved public knowledge, support, lead qualification, sales follow-up and customer continuity.
- Online Tools: practical browser utilities and low-friction product discovery.
- AI Life: persistent second-life experience centered on relationships, memory, home, career, economy, city, travel and events.
- KINGAI Pet: digital-pet companionship, collection, growth, team building and adventure.
- Digital Life: broader persistent digital identity, memory and character-continuity direction.

Recommended public navigation:
- Quick utility -> KING AI Online Tools.
- Productivity -> KINGAI Office.
- Device/file protection -> KINGAI Security.
- Infrastructure operations -> KINGAI OPS.
- Customer support/sales continuity -> KING AI Customer OS.
- AI-native computing -> KINGAI OS.
- Controlled multi-step agent work -> KINGAIBOT.
- Persistent virtual life -> AI Life.
- Digital pet collection/adventure -> KINGAI Pet.
- Persistent identity/memory category -> Digital Life.

Repository consolidation facts:
- Older product-specific public repositories are legacy discovery/history surfaces only.
- Legacy public repositories are not current source, installation or release authorities.
- Official product websites and this unified public hub are the preferred public discovery surfaces.
- Private production authorities remain the implementation/source authorities and are intentionally not mirrored here.

Independent related business:
- USDX TECH — https://usdxtech.com/ — independent business technology/product delivery surface; not a core KING AI product.

Founder personal-project exceptions, not KING AI ecosystem products:
- Jackhao.tv / Jackhao / 郝才子
- USChinese / 美国华人网
- ZuiMeiTV / 最美TV
- Atalk.TV

Roadmap interpretation:
- "roadmap", "product direction", "future direction", "long-term opportunity", and "designed to evolve toward" do not mean currently released.
- Do not infer unavailable features from strategic language.

Forbidden public inferences/content:
- production source code
- internal architecture or infrastructure topology
- private APIs or database schemas
- credentials, secrets or signing material
- proprietary algorithms
- security implementation
- deployment internals
- model configuration, prompts or orchestration internals
- confidential customer or operational information

Do not infer or fabricate revenue, ARR, users, installations, customers, signed partnerships, funding, valuation, certifications, market share or market leadership.

Verified release interpretation:
- A commit or CI build is not automatically a verified customer release.
- Use product-scoped current truth described in RELEASES.md.
- Historical assets in legacy repositories do not make those repositories current release authorities.

中文：
KING AI 当前采用“一个统一公开中心 + 各产品官方网站 + 旧公开仓迁移入口”的公开仓布局。
统一公开中心：https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public
主系统：https://www.kingai.work/
商务合作：vip@kingai.work

旧产品公开仓只属于 legacy 搜索/历史入口，不再是当前源码、安装或发布权威。公开信息不得包含生产源码、内部架构、私有 API、数据库、密钥、安全实现、部署细节、专有算法、模型配置或客户机密。

USDX TECH 是独立相关企业业务，不计入 KING AI 核心产品家族。
Jackhao.tv、USChinese/美国华人网、ZuiMeiTV/最美TV、Atalk.TV 是创始人独立个人项目，不属于 KING AI 主生态。
未来方向必须明确理解为路线图，不得推断为已经上线；不得虚构用户、收入、客户、合作、融资、估值、认证或市场领先地位。
